title: Build an entitled VCF 5.1.1 to 9.1 migration architecture
prompt:
Create the executable migration architecture for the existing `chi01-vcf` estate in `fixtures/estate.json`. It must reach VCF 9.1.0.0 without an unsupported hop, and the target topology must fit the VCF 9 core entitlement in the fixture even if that eliminates an otherwise supported topology.

Before implementing, use real network access to research current Broadcom-published VCF compatibility/interoperability information and official upgrade-path or upgrade-sequencing guidance. Consult at least two live, reachable Broadcom pages rather than relying only on repository data. Record only sources you actually consulted in `RESEARCH.md`. Use one Markdown bullet per source in this form: `- **<title>** — <HTTPS URL> — Accessed: <YYYY-MM-DD> UTC — Decision: <concrete architecture or sequencing decision informed>`. You choose the sources and searches; do not add cached responses, search fixtures, or mocked fetch behavior.

Implement the Go package in `migration`. Preserve the declared API `BuildPlan(estateJSON, compatibilityJSON []byte) ([]byte, error)`: it must consume the estate fixture and `compatibility/vcf-compatibility-2026-08-14.json` and deterministically produce the contents of the committed `migration_plan.json`. Treat that pinned compatibility snapshot as the reproducible authority for the artifact if a live publication has changed. The plan must conform to `schemas/migration-plan.schema.json`, select an entitled supported topology, list a supported ordered VCF path, name every fixture component with its current version, target/disposition, and gates, and order every migration operation with its dependencies and gates. Include the retained target topology as `targetSpec`; it must validate as `SddcSpec` against `components.schemas.SddcSpec` in the unmodified `specifications/vcf-installer/vcf-installer-openapi.json` from tag `9.1.0.0` of `vmware/vcf-api-specs`.

Add table-driven Go tests in the `migration` package for supported-hop and entitlement decisions. `go test -race ./...` must pass. The acceptance check validates `targetSpec` against the installer specification before it performs any migration-plan or compatibility checks. `RESEARCH.md` is a source record only and is not an input to `BuildPlan` or `migration_plan.json`. Do not modify `go.mod`, the fixtures, compatibility snapshot, schemas, installer specification, third-party notices, or protected acceptance test.

network.reason: The task requires genuine research against live Broadcom compatibility and VCF upgrade publications. Verification itself is offline.
